items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: And at that time, George Ybarquet was playing. Clionette, Manuel Sumpet. Buddy Johnson? Buddy Johnson, no. George Field. George Field. He played some boom.

ctx.x: Did you get any, belonged to any regular band then pretty soon? Oh yeah.

Yeah. I used to see, Jimmy and this boy was playing with the Imphil band, you see. Manuel. Manuel. Perez. Perez. He was kind of sickly, I think he had an ulcer in his stomach. Kind of sickly all the time. I used to play right regular with Manuel. And that's a Jimmy Brown. Yeah, and at that time, George Ybarquet was playing. Clionette, Manuel Sumpet. Buddy Johnson? Buddy Johnson, no. George Field. George Field. He played some boom. And this boy Nick. Henry Nickerson. Henry Nickerson was playing violin. Yeah.
I don't know much about him. Was he ever, any relation to Professor Nickerson? His son. Oh, it's his son. Yeah, I told you about it.
